checks.value: Congrats on being the most active user!

support.request_quote: Find a user who wrote the most total channel messages and write them the following message: Congrats on being the most active user!
support.reason: Bob wrote the most total channel messages (1 in general, 2 in Bob's user_inbox, but only channel messages count; Bob has 1 in general, others have 1 each except Charlie who has 2: general and private; but private is not a channel, so Bob, Charlie, Eve each have 1; tie, but Bob is first in list). The required message is to be sent to the most active user with the specified body.
